g.aria-label: Multivariable Differentiability: Genuine Linear Map Λ(ϵ)
ℓ(w + ϵ) = ℓ(w) + Λ(ϵ) + o(∥ϵ∥) where lim_{∥ϵ∥→0} o(∥ϵ∥)/∥ϵ∥ = 0
Probing along axis eᵢ (ϵ = h eᵢ) forces Λ(eᵢ) = ∂ℓ/∂wᵢ
Uniqueness of the Gradient Dot Product
Λ(∑ᵢ ϵᵢ eᵢ) = ∑ᵢ ϵᵢ (∂ℓ/∂wᵢ) = ϵ · ∇_w ℓ(w)
Coordinate changes add up cleanly ONLY when ℓ is differentiable at w!
Column gradient ∇_w ℓ ∈ ℝ^N matches the exact shape of parameter vector w ∈ ℝ^N
